Volume - 158 Issue 09 BENGALURU, WEDNESDAY, 11, JANUARY, 2023(PUSHYA, 21, SHAKAVARSHA, 1944)

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA

RD 02 PFH 2023 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:09-01-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village and
other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Navadagi of Bhalki taluk Bidar District and to constitute a new revenue village called
Bhavaninagar (Navadagi Thanda) as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government from
any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will be
considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner, Bidar District, Bidar

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 279 PFH 2022
Dated:-10/10/2022 regarding altering the limits of Vadagera village of Vadagera
Taluk and Yadagiri District and constituting a new revenue village called Biranakal,
Basavanagar And Sevalal Nagar was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette No. RD 279 PFH 2022 Dated:-12/10/2022 inviting objections or suggestions
from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:- 12.10.2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by the
State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

village Vadagera of Vadagera taluk in Yadagiri District to form a new revenue village

included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village and
other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Hullur

Village of Muddebihal taluk Vijayapur District and to constitute a new revenue village
called Venkateshnagar as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government from
any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will be
considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner, Vijayapur District, Vijayapur

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Hullur of Muddebihal taluk in Vijayapur District to form a new revenue
village called Venkateshnagar of Muddebihal taluk in Vijayapur district along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village and
other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Aliyabad
Village of Vijayapur taluk Vijayapur District and to constitute a new revenue village
called Manen Doddi, Jadhav Nagar, Pavaradevi Nagar, Jaibhavani Nagar,

Goradan Doddi, Pangron Doddi as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government from
any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will be
considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner,Vijayapur District,Vijayapur

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village and
other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Changlera of Chitaguppa taluk Bidar District and to constitute a new revenue village
called Chouki Tanda as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers
and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government from
any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will be
considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner, Bidar District, Bidar

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village and
other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Rudnoor
of Bhalki taluk Bidar District and to constitute a new revenue village called Ramnagar
as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to
them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government from
any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will be
considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner, Bidar District, Bidar

specified in column(2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
villages of Rudnoor of Bhalki taluk Bidar District to form a new revenue village called
as Ramnagar(Rudnoor Thanda) of Bhalki taluk Bidar District along with the survey
numbers included in column(4) thereof.

PRILIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka Act No. 12of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (IV) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area of The Village, The demand under Land Revenue in The
Village and having regard to the administrative convenience, the Government of
Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Chikkekereyaginahlli
Village of Sandur Taluk, Ballari District and to constitute a New Village Called
Shriramshettihalli as Specified in Schedule along With Maps With Old Survey
Numbers and New Survey Numbers assigned to Them.

Now therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby
that The proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from the Date
of Publication of the Notification in the Official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestions may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Ballari Disrict, Ballari.

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RD 415 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariet
Multi Storied Building
Bangaluru , Date :10-01-2022

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clause (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population , area under land revenue and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the Government of Karnataka proposes to alter the extent of residential
area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the boundary of
Chunganahalli village in Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk of Tumkur District to convert
the existing Shreemylarapura and Gantiganapalya unrecorded habitations in to a
hamlet/ extention/part of the existing revenue village. The area occupied by the said
hamlet of the village is specified in the schedule below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundry of
Chunganahalli village for conversion of Shreemylarapura and Gantiganapalya
unrecorded habitations in to hamlet/extention/part of the said revenue village.
Now therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the said Act ,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into considaration after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any persons with respect to the said proposel before the expiry of period specified
above will be considered by the state Government . Objections or suggetion may be
addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Tumkur district

SCHEDULE -1

Lands bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column(4) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Chunganahalli sub village of
Chikkanayakanahalli taluk of Tumkur district and convert the same to form hamlet
extention within the boundary of Chunganahalli Revenue village and same will here
in after be named as Shreemylarapura of Chunganahalli village in
Chikkanayakanahalli Taluk Tumkur District.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka Act 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors specified
in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such as the
population, area under land revenue and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the Government of Karnataka proposes to after, the extent of residential
area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the boundary of
Paramanandawadi Village of Raybag Taluk of Belagavi District to convert the
existing Brahmananda Colony unrecorded habitation in to a hamlet/extension /part of
the existing revenue village. The area occupied by the said hamlet of the village is
specified in the schedule below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Paramanandawadi village for conversion of Brahmananda Colony unrecorded
habitation in to hamlet/extension/ part of the said revenue village.
Now therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the person likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into consideration after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any persons with respect to the said proposal before the expiry of the period
specified above will be considered by the State Government Objections or suggestions
may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner of Belagavi District.
SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers and extent specified below in column (3) of the
table shall be declared as habitation area of Brahmananda Colony village of Raybag
Taluk of Belagavi District convert the same to form hamlet/extension within the
boundary of Paramanandawadi Revenue village and same will herein after be named
as Brahmananda Colony of Paramanandawadi village in Raybag Taluk of Belagavi
District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Where as the draft of the Notification No. RD 162 PFH 2022.
Dated: 13-10-2022 regarding altering the limits of Mududi village of Arsikere Taluk
and Hassan District and constituting a new revenue village called Shivajinagara and
Siddapura was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act,
1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 13 PFH 2021
dated:15-10-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:15-10-2022

And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 310 PFH 2022
Dated:05-11-2022 regarding altering the limits of Bhadrapur village of Chitaguppa
Taluk and Bidar District and constituting a new revenue village called Mokhin tanda
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette RD 310 PFH 2022
Dated:07-11-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:10-11-2022 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of
Bhadrapur said village of Chitaguppa taluk in Bidar District to form a new revenue
village called Mokhin tanda of Chitguppa taluk Bidar district along with survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification no. RD 362 PFH 2022 Dated:24/11/2022
regarding altering the limits of Goura village of Basavakalyan Taluk in Bidar District

and constituting a new revenue village called Goura Thanda was published as required
by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964)
in the Karnataka Gazette dated:25/11/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all
the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 25/11/2022.

And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Goura of Basavakalyan Taluk in Bidar District to form a new revenue village
called Goura Thanda of Basavakalyan Taluk in Bidar District along with survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification no. RD 363 PFH 2022
Dated:24/11/2022 regarding altering the limits of Kherda (B) village of Basavakalyan
Taluk in Bidar district and constituting a new revenue village called Bhavaninagar was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka
act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette Dated:25/11/2022 inviting objections or
suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the
date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated: 25/11/2022.

And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Kherda (B) of Basavakalyan Taluk in Bidar District to form a new revenue
village called Bhavaninagar of Basavakalyan Taluk in Bidar District along with
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 364 PFH 2022 Dated:24-11-2022
regarding altering the limits of Nandibijalgaon Village of Kamalnagar Taluk, Bidar
District and to constitute a new village called Nandibijalgaon Tanda was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka land Revenue Act 1964 (Karnataka act 12 of
1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No RD 364 PFH 2022 Dated:25-11-2022 inviting
Objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty
days from the date of its publication in the official gazette.

And Where as said the gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:25-11-2022 and where as Objections or suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;

Now therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Karnataka
land Revenue Act 1964 (Karnataka act 12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka hereby
makes the following notification ,namely.

SCHEDULE-I

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Nandibijalgaon of Kamalanagar Taluk, Bidar district to form a new revenue

village called as Nandibijalgaon Tanda of Kamalanagar Taluk, Bidar district along
with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

here by makes the following Notification namely:-

specified in column(2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said

included in column (4) thereof.
